hint_ladder.title: Spot the Idea
hint_ladder.text: Ubiquitous is about presence. Anong bagay ang laging nandyan? Like hangin o sari-sari store. Yun ang ibig sabihin.

hint_ladder.title: Rule: 'You be everywhere'
hint_ladder.text: Latin 'ubique' = everywhere. Kung ubiquitous, di mo maiwasan—parang traffic sa EDSA, nasa lahat ng oras.

hint_ladder.title: Eliminate Opposites
hint_ladder.text: Rare, scarce, hidden—lahat yan opposite ng everywhere. Alisin mo na; isa na lang natitira.

hint_ladder.title: Pick the One
hint_ladder.text: Everywhere ang tamang sagot. Tandaan, ubiquitous = present in all places, tulad ng hangin.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'rare' sounds special, but ubiquitous means common, the opposite.

B.text: You might have chosen B because scarce means limited, while ubiquitous means abundant everywhere—total opposite.

C.text: Correct. Ubiquitous means everywhere—parang hangin, di mo maiiwasan.

D.text: You might have chosen D because hidden means concealed, but ubiquitous is out in the open, visible everywhere.

next_time_rule: Ubiquitous = everywhere. Opposite: rare, scarce, hidden. Mnemonic: 'you be everywhere'—jeepney-like presence.
deconstruct_text:
Ubiquitous means present in all places—parang sari-sari store sa bawat kanto ng barangay natin. Latin root 'ubique' literally means 'everywhere.'

Compare mo sa choices: Rare (bihira), Scarce (kapos), Hidden (nakatago)—lahat opposite ng 'everywhere.' Simple lang, tatlo ang mali, isa ang tama.

Ang tamang sagot ay 'Everywhere.' Mental trick: 'You be everywhere'—parang jeepney na kahit saan may dumadaan.
